name: NVIDIA Motion Smoothing
author: zysilm
punchline: Smoother motion with real in-between frames from your NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPU
description:
Doubles the video's frame rate while it plays, with in-between frames made from the optical flow that the hardware of your NVIDIA GeForce RTX 30 series or newer GPU measures between frames: not blended frames. Video ▸ NVIDIA Motion Smoothing… opens a window to choose Off, Double Frame Rate or Match Display (the doubled frames paced to the display, with GPU rendering) and shows what runs or why not. The command palette and Ask Vestra can also choose a mode in one step. Needs Windows with an RTX 30 series or newer GPU and NVIDIA driver 573.38 or newer; it does nothing on other GPUs or systems. Off by default; remembers your choice.
